source: The demo above is one file, complete and runnable. Show code opens it under the board, Copy takes it, and the data behind it is the fixture named on this page.

meta.title: Empty schedule
meta.description: No items at all: the empty state, in the language of the page, and the buttons that are not drawn.

demos.board: A day with nothing on it

scenario: The same day, the same shifts, and not one item. An empty schedule is not an error and not a spinner — it is the shape of the day with nothing in it, which is what a reader needs to see before the first item arrives.
look: The message comes from the locale pack, so it is in the language of this page. <link to="/customization/localization/">Localization</link> shows how to replace it.
There are no navigation buttons: with nothing to jump to, they would only be disabled.
The two views handle it differently: the timeline keeps its hours and lays the message over them, the list gives up its sections for it.
The color scheme and the density still apply. An empty schedule is still a themed one.
uses: <link to="/states/">States</link> — the empty state, next to loading and error.
<link to="/customization/localization/">Localization</link> — every string here, including this one, comes from the pack.
<link to="/navigation/">Navigation</link> — the threshold that keeps the buttons away.
